title: Discovery & Scoping
description: We learn about your goals, users and constraints, then agree on scope, priorities and a realistic plan.

title: Design & Prototyping
description: We map the flows and design the interface, validating it with clickable prototypes before development.

title: Development & QA
description: We build in short iterations with regular demos, testing as we go so issues are caught early.

title: Launch & Ongoing Support
description: We deploy, monitor and hand over — and stay on to maintain and improve the product if you need us.
